hero.title: Study Computer Science in Mauritius for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Discover quality, affordable Computer Science education in Mauritius at internationally affiliated universities and branch campuses from the UK, France, and Australia. Indian students benefit from a safe, multicultural environment, low living costs, and straightforward visa processing.

overview: Mauritius is rapidly transforming into a regional technology and financial services hub for the Indian Ocean and African region. Pursuing Computer Science in Mauritius offers Indian students a unique, cost-effective opportunity to earn internationally recognized qualifications from renowned British, French, and Australian university branch campuses.

Institutions like the University of Mauritius, Université des Mascareignes, Middlesex University Mauritius, and Curtin Mauritius offer comprehensive undergraduate and postgraduate computing degrees. Programs cover programming fundamentals, database management, software engineering, network administration, and cloud technologies, taught in an English-speaking academic environment.

With competitive annual tuition fees (typically $2,500 to $8,500 USD), affordable student accommodation, and a streamlined visa application process with no complicated embassy interviews, Mauritius represents an accessible, high-value destination for students launching an international technology education.

universities.name: University of Mauritius (UoM)
universities.desc: UoM is the premier public research university of Mauritius, offering internationally recognized undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in science, engineering, and agriculture.

universities.name: Université des Mascareignes (UdM)
universities.desc: Partnered with Université de Limoges (France), UdM delivers dual European-Mauritian accredited diplomas with bilingual instruction and industry internships.

universities.name: Middlesex University Mauritius
universities.desc: A branch campus of Middlesex University London, delivering British honors degrees with global validation, modern coastal campus, and international faculty.

universities.name: Curtin Mauritius
universities.desc: An international campus of Curtin University Australia, providing accredited Australian business, IT, and humanities degrees in state-of-the-art facilities.
